Amazing Food and Host
May 2016 • Friends
We pre booked the dinner a month ago. Went to the wrong place and called the host for help. Shortly 2 lovely ladies on motorbikes came to our rescue and pick us up to the correct place. 

Dinner was served in the house garden. As there will only be one group of guests at anytime, we have all the privacy to our own. Food is nice and authentic but the serving is too big. 

After dinner, we chit chat in the tea room with the hosts and chef while being served with nice tea. 

Overall a very nice and unique dining experience. 

Highly recommended to visit this place in Hanoi.

Wonderful out of the way Restaurant!!! If you can't cook Vietnamese, you'll get first hand experience here!
Dec 2015 • Solo
It's located in a little alley near the West Lake area. One of my Vietnamese friends suggested I try this restaurant. It's a small, but quaint home with a pretty garden. Ms Lam is the owner and speaks English. Ms Lam has a cooking class and though I was very reluctant to cook a Vietnamese meal, but with both her and Ms. Hoa(the chief) encouraging me, I gave it a try. Ms. Hoa instructed, while Ms. Lam translated the directions for me in English. Whoa, I didn't realize I was such a great chief...lol!! They were very patient with me, but the dishes turned out real well. I was so pleased with the taste and quality. I really loved the desserts, as everything is homemade. This was a marvelous experience for me and when I come back to Hanoi, this will be my first stop!!!

Our family meal in the heart of Hanoi
Oct 2015 • Family
Maison des saveurs likes a home meal when you must to work far from your family. Sometimes when I miss my home, I come to Maison des saveurs to enjoy lunch or dinner. Lam - the owner is very young but dyamic, charming and so sweet. She built up Maison des saveurs by her love with Vietnamese foods and she passes her passion into every dishes. The house looks simple but unique. Food tastes are so familiar with the best foods from mom. I would recommend Maison des saveurs for all people who want to explore the real Vietnamese foods at a tranquil and relaxing place.

Amazing foods, tranquil setting and friendly staff!
Oct 2015 • Friends
It was a great experience with Maison des saveurs when I visit this lovely house to enjoy lunch and cooking class.

Maison Des Saveurs is located in a quiet alley near West Lake with easy access. Very nice local house where we enjoyed the tranquil atmostphere and play with their naughty dog named Hello. They also have a small nice garden with some herb and vegetable. 

After a delicious welcome drink, we enjoy a cooking class which is excellent with traditional dishes of Vietnam. Ms Lam was very friendly and knowledgeable, she helped us arrange the dishes and translated everything while Ms Hoa the chef instructed us to cook. I was impressed with the flavour of the dishes at lunch - they were all amazing! That was a funny time learning how to cook them (we even could bring the recipe back home, so we can cook them at home). 

Dessert was also stunning with home-made cakes, passion fruit mousse and tea. I wish I could have the lovely cakes everyday to enjoy with my tea because it exactly the best one I have tried in my life.

I highly recommend Maison Des Saveurs for anyone visiting Hanoi. That's not only the cooking class, the atmostphere or the yummy foods but also the friendliness and hospitality of Ms Lam and Ms Hoa. They will never let you down!
